title: Shortest Palindrome by Prepending
prompt:
Implement `shortest_palindrome_prefix(s)` to form the shortest palindrome obtainable by adding characters only before `s`. You may not append or insert characters elsewhere. Return the resulting string.

The input may contain any Python string character, including punctuation.

Target O(n) time and O(n) space. Empty and already-palindromic strings should be returned unchanged.

example.reasoning: The longest palindromic prefix is `'aa'`; reversing the remaining suffix `'b'` gives the only needed prefix.
